Problem Statement Fractional Power Composite Rule
Find the derivative with respect to xxx of the function:
y=(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)5/2y = (2x^{3/2} - 3x^{4/3} - 5)^{5/2}y=(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)5/2
STEP 1 প্রদত্ত ভগ্নাংশীয় ঘাত ফাংশনটি উল্লেখ করি (Given Fractional Power Function)
y=(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)5/2y = (2x^{3/2} - 3x^{4/3} - 5)^{5/2}y=(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)5/2
STEP 2 উভয়পক্ষে xxx-এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরণ করি (Differentiating both sides w.r.t. xxx)
dydx=ddx[(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)5/2]\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{d}{dx}\left[ (2x^{3/2} - 3x^{4/3} - 5)^{5/2} \right]dxdy​=dxd​[(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)5/2]
STEP 3 শক্তি বিধি ও চেইন রুল প্রয়োগ করি (ddx[un]=nun−1dudx\frac{d}{dx}[u^n] = n u^{n-1} \frac{du}{dx}dxd​[un]=nun−1dxdu​)
dydx=52(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)52−1⋅ddx(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{5}{2}(2x^{3/2} - 3x^{4/3} - 5)^{\frac{5}{2} - 1} \cdot \frac{d}{dx}(2x^{3/2} - 3x^{4/3} - 5)dxdy​=25​(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)25​−1⋅dxd​(2x3/2−3x4/3−5) dydx=52(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)3/2⋅ddx(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{5}{2}(2x^{3/2} - 3x^{4/3} - 5)^{3/2} \cdot \frac{d}{dx}(2x^{3/2} - 3x^{4/3} - 5)dxdy​=25​(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)3/2⋅dxd​(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)
STEP 4 বন্ধনীভুক্ত প্রতিটি ভগ্নাংশীয় ঘাতের অন্তরক নির্ণয় করি (Differentiating Fractional Powers)
ddx(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)=2(32x32−1)−3(43x43−1)−0=3x1/2−4x1/3\frac{d}{dx}(2x^{3/2} - 3x^{4/3} - 5) = 2\left(\frac{3}{2}x^{\frac{3}{2}-1}\right) - 3\left(\frac{4}{3}x^{\frac{4}{3}-1}\right) - 0 = 3x^{1/2} - 4x^{1/3}dxd​(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)=2(23​x23​−1)−3(34​x34​−1)−0=3x1/2−4x1/3
STEP 5 মান বসিয়ে চূড়ান্ত বীজগাণিতিক অন্তরজ পাই (Final Form)
dydx=52(3x1/2−4x1/3)(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)3/2=52(3x−4x3)(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)3/2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{5}{2}(3x^{1/2} - 4x^{1/3})(2x^{3/2} - 3x^{4/3} - 5)^{3/2} = \frac{5}{2}(3\sqrt{x} - 4\sqrt[3]{x})(2x^{3/2} - 3x^{4/3} - 5)^{3/2}dxdy​=25​(3x1/2−4x1/3)(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)3/2=25​(3x​−43x​)(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)3/2
FINAL ANSWER dydx=52(3x1/2−4x1/3)(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)3/2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{5}{2}(3x^{1/2} - 4x^{1/3})(2x^{3/2} - 3x^{4/3} - 5)^{3/2}dxdy​=25​(3x1/2−4x1/3)(2x3/2−3x4/3−5)3/2

⚠️ Box 2: Common Student Traps & Pitfalls
  • Arithmetic Mistakes in Exponent Subtraction: Writing 43−1=12\frac{4}{3} - 1 = \frac{1}{2}34​−1=21​ instead of 13\frac{1}{3}31​, or 52−1=12\frac{5}{2} - 1 = \frac{1}{2}25​−1=21​ instead of 32\frac{3}{2}23​.
  • Forgetting to Cancel Coefficients: 2×32=32 \times \frac{3}{2} = 32×23​=3 and 3×43=43 \times \frac{4}{3} = 43×34​=4. Missing these cancellations leaves unsimplified fractions.
